title: TransferMechanism
description: GDPR-sourced archetype — international data transfer mechanisms under Regulation (EU) 2016/679. Chapter V (Articles 44-49) restricts transfers of personal data to third countries or international organisations unless appropriate safeguards are in place. Rootless — regulatory compliance dimension. Source: GDPR Articles 44-49.

internationalTransfer.description: Whether personal data is transferred to a third country or international organisation. Source: GDPR Art 44.

transferMechanism.description: The legal mechanism enabling the transfer. ADEQUACY_DECISION: European Commission decision that third country ensures adequate protection (Art 45). STANDARD_CONTRACTUAL_CLAUSES: SCCs adopted by Commission or supervisory authority (Art 46(2)(c)-(d)). BINDING_CORPORATE_RULES: BCRs approved by competent supervisory authority (Art 47). APPROVED_CODE_OF_CONDUCT: code of conduct with binding commitments from third-country controller/processor (Art 46(2)(e)). APPROVED_CERTIFICATION: approved certification mechanism with binding commitments (Art 46(2)(f)). AD_HOC_CONTRACTUAL_CLAUSES: contractual clauses authorised by supervisory authority (Art 46(3)(a)). ADMINISTRATIVE_ARRANGEMENTS: arrangements between public authorities authorised by supervisory authority (Art 46(3)(b)). DEROGATION: specific situation derogations under Art 49(1).

transferSafeguardInPlace.description: Whether the appropriate safeguard for the selected transfer mechanism is in place and enforceable. Source: GDPR Art 46(1).

supplementaryMeasuresApplied.description: Whether supplementary measures have been applied to ensure the level of protection is essentially equivalent to that guaranteed within the EU. Relevant post-Schrems II (CJEU C-311/18). Source: EDPB Recommendations 01/2020.

transferImpactAssessmentPerformed.description: Whether a transfer impact assessment has been performed to evaluate the legal framework of the third country and whether supplementary measures are needed. Source: EDPB Recommendations 01/2020.
